originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Baruah-Das-Talukdar Thm 6.1(6.8) proves only single-level d_4(343n+j)=0 mod 7 for j in {39,235,284} via Radu algorithm (verified in full-text HTML: statement plus (343,14,14,39) certificate); it states no mod-49 claim for d_4 and its (6.7) mod-49 claim is for d_3 only. Chen-Xu-Yin proves infinite 7-power towers only for d_3/d_5, leaving k=4 unrecorded. da Silva-Hirschhorn-Sellers transfer theorem (d_k=>d_{p^N j+k}) is a positive lifting rule and does not imply negative non-vanishing facts nor the exact residues 14,21,14. Guadalupe (mod 5/25/125) and Banerjee-Smoot (d_5 mod 5-powers) are different prime/k. No source records 'no 343-class vanishes mod 49', 'no 49-class vanishes mod 49', or the minimal witnesses d_4(39)=14, d_4(235)=21, d_4(970)=14 mod 49. The negative diagonal-lift facts are therefore new.

value.rationale: Strongest headline judged alone: certified sharpness/non-lift of the known d_4 mod-7 singles at the natural diagonal step 343. Object d_4 with generating function (q^2;q^2)^4/(q;q)^13 is a natural Andrews-Paule diamond family; invariant (failure of diagonal lift to mod 49 everywhere, with exact minimal witnesses) was motivated before computation by the missing k=4 7-power tower program, is not known or mechanically implied by the mod-7 singles or the general-k transfer theorem, and is directly reusable: any future d_4 mod-49 tower must use non-diagonal steps/residues (draft explicitly preserves the 2401-subprogression opening, e.g. n=1754 term 0 mod 49). This is a complete finite census at step 343 (all 343 classes) plus the 49-class corollary, honestly scoped, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration. Narrowness (one modulus/step plus witnesses) does not disqualify per exact-invariant guidance; failed tower/U-lemma does not erase this independently retrievable constraint.
